I have two issues with the game right now. I'm loving the hell out of it, but there are two main issues that disappoint me. The side-missions are repetitive as hell and don't provide any benefit after you hit level 30. No special high level rewards or anything.

That and end game (PvE) content is non-existent beyond replaying the same 16 main missions on hard or challenging. Hard is super easy once you hit a minimum of 75k dps. Challenging I have not actually been able to play yet because my group hasn't been available, but what I know is that it's gonna be rough for us. It's almost insane that they are charging $40 for a season pass that is going to add maybe one "raid" like mission.

The game desperately needs a more active world. Random encounters, random events, etc. Something to the extent of a heli comes crashing down in an area and you are asked to assist the pilot who cannot move by themselves and get them to the Base of Operations or something. Stuff like that would make just running around more interesting.

I can definitely agree that The Division is taking itself too seriously as well.

I used side missions to level up to 30 pretty quick, honestly. Past that, I did them to simply complete all the content since I'm a completionist. I was slightly annoyed that the blueprints were pretty much worthless but that didn't matter when I got to level 30 and had to craft most of my upper level gear.

Challenge mode is pretty fun, honestly, since it requires coordination from the rest of your squad. My gaming community typically has 5 or 6 groups running the daily challenge mission when it pops at 8 EST, so if you're interested in joining us, contact me. As far as the "raid" missions, incursions will actually be part of the free update apparently and will drop on all platforms in April and May. Past that, there are three expansions which are covered by the season pass. I'm not sure if there will be more than the two free incursions that they are adding in the next two months but we'll see. D3 had VERY different plans for content progression in the beginning and those changed. Granted, this is an Ubisoft product so it's possible that they may replace all content with steaming butts just because it's Ubisoft and they're fucked in the head. That being said, Massive Entertainment (the devs) seem to be fairly intelligent.

I do agree with the random events, however, as running circuits in the DZ for landmark events is a bit repetitive. Granted, this is supposed to gear us for incursions. That being said, hopefully Massive gets the hint and puts in something like that. As mentioned previously, they seem to be reasonably intelligent. Hopefully Ubisoft won't gut them of talent or drive it away. That's what worries me the most, honestly.

Unfortunately, the only people getting access to anything next month is Xbox. PC and PS4 have to wait until May for the first incursion release, then june for the second. Which is total bullshit, but who am I to say so.
